q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING (COUNT(EMAIL) > 1)
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING (COUNT(EMAIL) > 1)
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are semantically equivalent.
